title: Glowing rain cloud
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='cloudGlow' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#6a9fd8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3a5f9e'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='dropGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7dd4ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3aacff'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- cloud glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='38' ry='22' fill='#2a4a7a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- main cloud body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='28' ry='16' fill='url(#cloudGlow)'/>
  <!-- cloud bumps -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='36' r='13' fill='#5a8fc8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='16' fill='#6a9fd8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='36' r='13' fill='#5a8fc8'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='32' r='12' fill='#6298d0'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='32' r='12' fill='#6298d0'/>
  <!-- cloud highlight rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='26' rx='14' ry='7' fill='#8ab8e8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- raindrops -->
  <path d='M32 58 Q32 68 37 68 Q42 68 42 58 Q37 50 32 58Z' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
  <path d='M46 62 Q46 72 51 72 Q56 72 56 62 Q51 54 46 62Z' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
  <path d='M60 58 Q60 68 65 68 Q70 68 70 58 Q65 50 60 58Z' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
  <path d='M40 74 Q40 82 44 82 Q48 82 48 74 Q44 68 40 74Z' fill='#5ac0ff'/>
  <path d='M56 74 Q56 82 60 82 Q64 82 64 74 Q60 68 56 74Z' fill='#5ac0ff'/>
  <!-- drop highlights -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='59' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#b0e8ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='63' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#b0e8ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='59' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#b0e8ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- friendly face on cloud -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#c8ecff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#c8ecff'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='39.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='39.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M46 46 Q50 50 54 46' stroke='#c8ecff' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='45' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#8ab8e8' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='45' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#8ab8e8' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
